answer: Make each identity vertex pay a burn-cost to join: a slow verifiable-work puzzle — trivial for one, like shelling a walnut by hand, ruinous for a million. Voting weight then grows like a willow, slow-ringed by tenure, so fresh accounts hold near-zero sway. A sybil farm of 10k nodes pays 10k× burn yet captures nothing for weeks. Attack cost exceeds any governance value.
